- WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER generated £3.9k revenue TW, the highest performing product, with 57 orders.
- ENGLISH ROSE DESIGN QUILTED THROW achieved £2.9k revenue TW, placing it as the second strongest revenue driver.
- SET/6 WOODLAND PAPER PLATES led unit sales with 12,976 units TW, followed closely by SET/6 STRAWBERRY PAPER CUPS at 12,960 units TW.
- SET/6 WOODLAND PAPER CUPS showed exceptional growth of 39,107.8% WoW in revenue, indicating a significant surge in demand.
- SET/6 WOODLAND PAPER PLATES demonstrated strong momentum with 26,359.8% revenue growth WoW.
- Total revenue reached £36.2k TW compared to £16.3k LW, representing a 122.2% WoW increase across all products.
- Total unit volume TW was 60,748 units across 499 orders, demonstrating strong customer engagement.
- REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER contributed £2.5k revenue TW with 41 orders, establishing itself as a consistent performer.
